note: Simulated issue tracker used for offline demos. Not real customer data.

issues.title: Checkout hangs after entering card details
issues.body: Since this morning, customers who enter card details at checkout see a spinner forever. Several customers have phoned about it. Card numbers like 4111 1111 1111 1111 are being used in testing.

issues.title: Report export to Excel shows wrong totals
issues.body: The Excel export of the monthly sales report includes refunded orders in the totals, so the numbers do not match the dashboard.

issues.title: Allow customers to save favourite products
issues.body: Our customers would like a wishlist so they can save products and buy them later.
